messages:
Olivia (Finance): Heads-up — got invoice 98765 for Kunden GmbH (EU private). Platform fee looks ~€20k higher than the renewal quote. Can someone reconcile?
BillingBot: Invoice 98765 generated. Total: €124,880. Line items: `platform_fee_private: €100,000`, `support_premium: €20,000`, `onprem_license: €4,880`. Payment terms: Net30.
Mateo (FinanceOps): Checking now. I see an extra line `platform-fee-regional-surcharge: €20,000`. Not in the signed quote. Can you point to the contract version?
Priya (AE): Kunden requested on‑prem rollout and upgraded to Premium Support via email on 2026-01-10 (I have the thread). They also requested EU region deployment. I thought we had EU surcharge logic in the SOW.
Lars (CS): Contract (SOW v3) shows Platform Base €80k + "region add" — but percentage is written as 25% in SOW v3, while quote used 20%. Might be a mismatch between legal copy and sales quote.
Mateo (FinanceOps): Can someone confirm whether the platform surcharge should be 20% or 25%? Also pulling provisioning logs to verify active dedicated nodes — want to ensure we didn't double-count capacity.
Marta (FinanceOps): Provisioning shows two adds for Kunden: 2026-01-12 added 4 dedicated GPUs, 2026-01-20 added 4 more as a test. The second set was flagged as "test" and should not bill. Looks like billing picked both.
Olivia (Finance): If test nodes were billed, we need a corrected invoice and credit memo. Also need clarification on support proration: customer upgraded support on Jan 10 but asked billing effective Jan 1 — does SOW allow retroactive billing?
Priya (AE): They asked effective Jan 1 in the same email. Sales leadership verbally approved pending formal change order. I don't see a signed CO to back Jan 1 effective date, only approval to bill from the change date.
Mateo (FinanceOps): Okay — two action items: (1) correct platform surcharge if SOW/quote mismatch, (2) remove test instance charges. I'll open BILL-4321 to track.
Marta (FinanceOps): Created provisional credit CM-9102 for -€10,000 to account for the test instance duplication. Pending manual approval from Finance Ops lead.
BillingBot: Credit memo CM-9102 created (status: pending_approval).
Lars (CS): Please cc the Kunden billing contact on the corrected invoice delivery and include an explanation line: "Removed test provisioning charges".
Olivia (Finance): Agreed. Can we get corrected invoice + credit by EOD Wednesday (European timezone)? AP needs it to process payment.
Mateo (FinanceOps): Will aim for EOD Wed. If we need legal confirmation on surcharge, loop in @Priya and @Lars — I won't finalize until we confirm 20% vs 25%.
Priya (AE): I'll re-send the signed quote and the email approval to the thread. If sales leader confirms, we can honor Jan 1 effective date; otherwise we'll prorate from Jan 10.
Marta (FinanceOps): Next steps: issue corrected invoice draft, attach CM-9102, wait for sales leader sign-off on support effective date, then finalize. I estimate finalization by 2026-02-05 if approvals are slow, or EOD Wed if approvals come today.
Olivia (Finance): Thanks — please post the draft here when ready. Also add the AP contact: accounts.payable@kunden.de.
Mateo (FinanceOps): Noted. Creating BILL-4321 and tagging @Priya for sign-off.
Priya (AE): :eyes: on it. I'll respond within the hour.
Lars (CS): Thx all — I'll prepare the short note to Kunden once we have the draft.
